scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.build:full: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install
